svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.42k stars in total, about 1.85k a year earlier. jactionlint 337, mr boxington 770, aube 2074, fnox 2389, hk 1319, pitchfork 716, usage 1077, +6 more 741.

g.text: $ gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers --paginate # every tool except mise
cumulative stars since Jan 2025, stacked by launch
